title: I’ve uploaded my first video game.
author: Moist_Show7700
selftext:
I’ve created a virtual card game; although it’s a prototype, I hope everyone enjoys it. You can find the game here: [https://mrody25.itch.io/sotacabrona](https://mrody25.itch.io/sotacabrona) . I hope you have fun with it. Oh, and by the way, it’s also available for mobile... MADE in Claude.

I created the artwork using ChatGPT, and built practically the entire game using Claude—though the programming agent from OpenCode (Big Pickle) helped convert it into both a desktop and an Android app. All the AI ​​tools I use are free, and I really push them to their absolute limit. I’d like to optimize things further to make the experience smoother for both myself and my players; for instance, I’d love to be able to work on the mobile and desktop versions simultaneously, or implement a reliable update system—one that ensures players’ data isn’t lost whenever I push an update. If you have any suggestions, let me know in the comments—and don't forget to give it a try! ;)
